key_catalyst: Hormuz blockade now operational with US-Iran strikes entering third night; Brent crude above $85
reasoning: On 7/13, QQQ fell -1.90% when US-Iran strikes and Strait of Hormuz closure FEARS first emerged; today the blockade is actually OPERATIONAL with a third night of strikes, commercial traffic collapsed to record lows, and Brent up 9.6%—yet QQQ is bouncing +0.95% on CPI expectations that have not even been confirmed. The market is pricing in a soft CPI print while materially underpricing an active blockade on ~20% of global oil flow, a clear escalation from yesterday's fear to today's reality.
